08 · Agent handoff

Component-generation brief

Build specialized components for a multi-domain case-management platform. COMPONENT FAMILIES 1. Inputs - structured short answer - long-form rationale - discrete authored judgment - currency input with unit and basis - three-point estimate: low / expected / high - evidence-linked claim - confidence input - stakeholder role assignment 2. Money and value - primary value with period - cost / benefit / net stack - payback period - scenario comparison - initial versus validated estimate - benefit composition - value range and uncertainty 3. Stats and indicators - completion - confidence - stage progress - trend - readiness matrix - independent health signals - evidence strength 4. Diagrams - process flow - decision tree - timeline - relationship map - stakeholder network - influence matrix - dependency chain 5. Evidence and structured information - evidence list - dense case table - inherited field with provenance - decision record - supersession comparison - artifact metadata 6. States and feedback - meaningful empty states - field validation - evidence gaps - blocked state - ready-for-decision state - incomplete artifact state DESIGN RULES - Every component must represent a real case concept - Inputs should signal whether they capture fact, judgment, assumption, estimate, or rationale - Money must always show currency, period, basis, and provenance - Uncertainty must use redundant cues: visual range plus explicit labels - Stats should support decisions, not decorate dashboards - Preserve earlier assumptions when values are revised - Show provenance directly in inherited values - Use diagrams only when relationships or sequence are easier to understand visually - Keep components mobile-safe and keyboard accessible - Reuse the same tokens, spacing, typography, and state language across domains
